description: This file defines the 'FoodOrderPage' widget for a Flutter app, including UI components such as the app bar, cart items, promo code input, total calculation, and payment method selection. It also contains several stateless widgets used within the page.

classes.name: FoodOrderPage
classes.description: Main page widget representing a food ordering cart interface with list of items, promo code input, total calculations, and payment options.

classes.name: _FoodOrderPageState
classes.description: State class managing the UI state of FoodOrderPage, including building the layout with various widgets.

classes.name: PaymentMethodWidget
classes.description: Stateless widget displaying the available payment method with an icon and label.

classes.name: TotalCalculationWidget
classes.description: Stateless widget showing the price breakdown and total cost of the cart items.

classes.name: PromoCodeWidget
classes.description: Stateless widget providing a text input for entering a promo code.

classes.name: CartItem
classes.description: Stateless widget representing an individual cart item with product image, name, price, quantity controls, and delete option.

classes.name: CartIconWithBadge
classes.description: Stateless widget displaying a cart icon with a badge showing the item count.

classes.name: AddToCartMenu
classes.description: Stateless widget with controls to increase or decrease the quantity of a cart item.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the FoodOrderPage widget.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI layout for each widget in the page.
